summary: Window 2026-08-17 to 2026-10-11 (56 days from signup), America/New_York. 95 emails read across four inboxes: 11 from Kettlewick Tea Co. and 84 from three rivals. Biggest gaps: your welcome email arrives 24 hours after signup while every rival's arrives within 4 minutes, and you send 4 emails in the first 14 days against a rival median of 8.

side_by_side.measure: Minutes from signup to first email
Regular emails a week, days 14 to 55, sale emails left out
Labor Day: first email, days before

rival_profiles.signup_page_says: Popup on the home page: Join the list for 15% off your first order
rival_profiles.summary: 15% off first order at signup; first email after 2 minutes and 8 emails in the first 14 days. About 2.0 regular sends a week, 21.7% promotional, median subject 19 characters. Labor Day: 3 emails from 4 days before, deepest offer 20% off.

rival_profiles.signup_page_says: Footer form: Get our three-part brewing guide, plus a free sample with your first order
rival_profiles.summary: free sample with first order at signup; first email after 4 minutes and 8 emails in the first 14 days. About 1.5 regular sends a week, 11.1% promotional, median subject 28 characters. Labor Day: 1 email from 2 days before, deepest offer free shipping.

rival_profiles.signup_page_says: Popup three seconds after the page loads: Unlock 20% off. Enter your email.
rival_profiles.summary: 20% off first order at signup, climbing to 25% for people who don't buy; first email after 1 minute and 13 emails in the first 14 days. About 3.8 regular sends a week, 74.4% promotional, median subject 22 characters. Labor Day: 7 emails from 5 days before, deepest offer 25% off, and a deadline that was extended.

adopt.change: Send welcome email 1 the moment someone joins, not a day later.
adopt.evidence: Your first email arrived 1442 minutes after signup. 3 of 3 rivals sent theirs within 10 minutes: Larkmoor Tea 2 min, Mistlecombe Tea 4 min, Pellridge Tea 1 min.
adopt.why_adopt_not_test: Timing only: no extra sends and no extra discount.
adopt.where: Klaviyo, Welcome Series: remove the time delay before email 1.

adopt.change: Announce the Labor Day sale to subscribers at least 2 days before the holiday.
adopt.evidence: Your only Labor Day email went out on the day itself. Larkmoor Tea started 4 days before, Mistlecombe Tea started 2 days before, Pellridge Tea started 5 days before.
adopt.why_adopt_not_test: The offer stays the same; only the announcement moves earlier.

avoid.pattern: Pellridge Tea: subject "Re: your order?" with no order and no earlier thread
avoid.why: A reply-style subject on a marketing email misleads the reader; US CAN-SPAM forbids deceptive subject lines.

avoid.pattern: Pellridge Tea: the Labor Day sale said it ended, then came back as "extended"
avoid.why: A deadline that moves teaches subscribers to ignore the next deadline.

avoid.pattern: Pellridge Tea: discounts up to 25% off, above your 20% ceiling; the welcome offer climbs 20% to 25% for people who don't buy
avoid.why: Matching it costs margin you said you won't give, and a climbing welcome offer teaches new subscribers to wait.

tests.name: Shorter campaign subject lines
tests.hypothesis: Subjects of about 22 characters, like the rivals', get more clicks than your 69-character subjects.
tests.change: Split each weekly campaign 50/50: your usual subject against a version under 35 characters that leads with the product or the number.
tests.metric: Click rate (opens are inflated by Apple Mail Privacy Protection)
tests.guardrail: Unsubscribe rate no higher than the control's

tests.name: A longer welcome series
tests.hypothesis: Two more welcome emails in the first 14 days (rivals send a median of 8 emails then, you send 4) turn more new subscribers into first orders.
tests.change: Split the Welcome Series: half get today's 2 emails, half get 4, with a brewing guide on day 3 and a bestsellers email on day 8.
tests.metric: Welcome Series orders per new subscriber
tests.guardrail: Welcome unsubscribe rate no higher than the control's

tests.name: A deeper signup offer
tests.hypothesis: 15% off the first order (the rival median) wins enough extra first orders to pay for the 5 points more than your 10%.
tests.change: Split the signup form and Welcome 1: half see 10% off, half see 15% off.
tests.metric: Welcome 1 placed-order rate, then margin per new subscriber
tests.guardrail: Margin per new subscriber after the discount must not fall

handoffs.gap: You send 1.0 regular emails a week; the rival median is 2.0.
handoffs.next_step: Frequency changes are not tested here, because each person's reaction builds over weeks. Use email-campaign-calendar, if installed, to pick a frequency from your own unsubscribe, complaint and revenue history and to size that test.

not_captured: Abandoned cart, browse and post-purchase emails: the research inboxes only signed up, so no rival flow beyond the welcome was triggered.
Rivals' open, click and order rates: no inbox can see them, so rival patterns are evidence of what they do, not proof that it works.
Personalization by first name: the research inboxes signed up without a name.
Each rival's sale calendar beyond Labor Day: the window holds one sale event.
changes_made: None. This skill reads and compares; it changes nothing in Klaviyo.
